title: The impact of APC mutation on the efficacy of anti-EGFR therapy in metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS wild type: a retrospective analysis.
caption: Kaplan–Meier curve of progression-free survival according to APC mutation status.
context: Kaplan–Meier curve of progression-free survival according to APC mutation status. The median PFS was 20.9 months (95% CI, 14.5–NA) in patients with APC mutation and 11.0 months (95% CI, 8.7–NA) with APC wild type ( Figure 1 ).
